commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+7' 2 - 2 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Souleymane Isaak Toure and Romain Faivre (Lorient) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 2:2.
90+7' Marc Bollengier blows the whistle, Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) is penalised for a foul.
90+6' Romain Faivre (Lorient) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.

90+6' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
90+5' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) attempts to find Ismail Jakobs with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
90+4' A clumsy foul by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle.
90+4' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
90+2' Igor Silva (Lorient) sends a chip pass into the box, but Philipp Kohn is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+1' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Great ball in from Maghnes Akliouche. Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
88' That's a well-taken pass by Krepin Diatta (Monaco). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
88' A player from Lorient commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
87' The resulting corner from Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) comes to nothing.

87' Igor Silva (Lorient) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lorient.
87' Caio Henrique swings in the free kick towards Stephane Singo (Monaco), who powers a header well wide of the right post from close in.
86' Caio Henrique (Monaco) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takumi Minamino trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ismail Jakobs (Monaco).
86' Poor challenge! Montassar Talbi (Lorient) is penalised for tripping and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Free kick. Monaco will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
84' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Takumi Minamino (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eliot Matazo (Monaco) is coming onto the pitch as Denis Zakaria cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
82' A substitution has been made. Aiyegun Tosin is replaced by Sirine Doucoure (Lorient).
81' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lorient.
80' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
79' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

78' It could have been a good chance to score! Igor Silva (Lorient) fails to release Romain Faivre with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears. The referee blows his whistle, Lorient are awarded a corner kick.
75' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marc Bollengier who sees an offensive foul.
72' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
70' Vincent Le Goff comes off the pitch to be replaced by Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
70' The referee allows time for a substitution. Julien Ponceau will be replaced by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
70' Here is a change. Gedeon Kalulu is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Igor Silva (Lorient).
69' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Aleksandr Golovin tees up Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Yvon Mvogo.
68' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
66' Substitution. Youssouf Fofana makes his way off the pitch and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) comes on as his replacement.
66' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Wissam Ben Yedder and he is replaced by Folarin Balogun (Monaco).
66' Substitution. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) replaces Vanderson.
65' Vanderson (Monaco) smashes the ball with a volley from the edge of the box, but his poor attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
65' Caio Henrique (Monaco) tries to find Wissam Ben Yedder, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
64' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tries to find Wissam Ben Yedder with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
63' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and signals a foul after Julien Ponceau (Lorient) brought his opponent down.
62' My Gran could have done better! Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
61' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) takes a short corner kick.

61' Romain Faivre (Lorient) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Lorient will have a corner.
61' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

60' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play and Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
59' Romain Faivre (Lorient) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Lorient will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
58' Stephane Singo (Monaco) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo keeps it out with an amazing save.
58' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Vanderson (Monaco). Monaco earn a corner.
55' It is time for a substitution. Theo Le Bris (Lorient) is on for Eli Junior Kroupi.
54' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
52' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
51' Yvon Mvogo makes a brilliant save! Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the middle of the goal.

48' Caio Henrique (Monaco) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
48' Caio Henrique (Monaco) will take a corner kick.
47' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Yvon Mvogo makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
47' The resulting corner from Romain Faivre (Lorient) is cleared.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Marc Bollengier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
45+1' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) trips an opposition player and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' The free kick from Romain Faivre (Lorient) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
43' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) is able to continue to play.

43' Stephane Singo (Monaco) leaps above the defender and heads the ball goalwards from a corner by Caio Henrique, but his effort from the penalty spot flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
43' Caio Henrique (Monaco) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
42' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) picks up an injury.
41' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner.

36' He should have scored! Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the right post is pretty weak and Philipp Kohn makes an easy save.
35' Neat passing move from Lorient in order to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Vanderson (Monaco) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Yvon Mvogo makes a comfortable save.

31' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
31' Vanderson (Monaco) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
29' Stephane Singo (Monaco) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yvon Mvogo, who smothers the ball.
26' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

25' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
24' Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
21' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yvon Mvogo comes off the line to clear the ball away.
19' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
17' 1 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Youssouf Fofana sets up Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
16' Vanderson (Monaco) jumps into a tackle and Marc Bollengier signals a foul.
15' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
14' Caio Henrique (Monaco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball. Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
14' Caio Henrique (Monaco) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
14' Stephane Singo (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Monaco are awarded a corner kick.
12' Caio Henrique (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
12' A cross into the box from Vanderson (Monaco) is cleared. Monaco have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Laurent Abergel (Lorient). Marc Bollengier saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
6' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

6' Good chance! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.

2' 1 - 0 Goal! Eli Junior Kroupi displays great vision and sends a pass to Tosin Aiyegun (Lorient), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Monaco will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marc Bollengier.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
